situation.text: New residents, short-stay workers or students, and people who may already have a BSN.

steps.text: If staying over four months, register as a resident with the municipality where you live.
steps.title: Step 1

steps.text: For a stay of four months or less, check RNI eligibility. Leiden accepts European passports; people without a European passport are directed to Breda or Venlo.
steps.title: Step 2

steps.text: Complete the RNI pre-registration, keep the QR code and book an available appointment. Bring ID. If you already have a BSN, do not apply as a new RNI registration; ask the municipality which update is needed.
steps.title: Step 3

documents.text: RNI: passport or identity card, not a driving licence, plus QR code. Under-16s attend with a parent and the required legalised birth document.
